oh.write: A board and batten gable and a covered porch face the street, set behind a wide concrete front walk and a lawn, with Hardi Plank siding. Inside, wood-look floors run from the Living Room through the Dining Area to the Kitchen and the Breakfast Nook, and a short hall leads to the private side of the house, with both baths. The Primary Bedroom sits at the back under the only vaulted ceiling in the house, with an exposed painted beam. A driveway runs back beside the house to the covered garage and an open concrete patio at the rear of the fenced lot, and the house has never flooded.
